description: This Java class provides authentication utilities for API tests in the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for cookie-based login and optional bearer token retrieval, facilitating authenticated API requests.

classes.name: AuthClient
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to perform authentication actions such as login using cookies or retrieving bearer tokens for API testing.

methods.name: loginWithCookies
methods.description: Performs a cookie-based login to the OrangeHRM API at the specified endpoint, returning session cookies for use in subsequent requests.

methods.name: bearerToken
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth2 bearer token from system properties or environment variables, if available.

methods.name: safeBody
methods.description: A private helper method that safely extracts and truncates the response body for logging or error messages.
